detail.longDescription: In LiteLLM 1.107.0, running pip to remove the bad package re-ran the malware. The wheels shipped cook.pth and sitecustomize.py, which Python's site module executes at startup, so any Python process in that env fired it, whether or not it imports litellm. LiteLLM's guidance: delete those files, kill the daemon holding /tmp/remote_code_loader.lock, rebuild, rotate keys. https:// docs.litellm.ai/blog/security- incident-oct-21-2026 # Python # Cybersecurity # SupplyChain # AIAgents
